Le gouvernement algérien accélère sa tra: The Algerian government is accelerating its digital transition with the launch of an intensive testing phase for its National Digital Services Portal (PN2D), a unified platform aimed at modernizing access to public services. Between March 1 and May 9, 2026, full-scale tests are evaluating performance and service quality, in a context marked by the challenges of technological sovereignty and digital inclusion.
L’Algérie franchit une étape décisive da: Algeria is taking a decisive step in its digital transformation with the National Digital Services Portal (PN2D), a flagship project led by the Presidency of the Republic and the Prime Minister. This unified platform, currently in an intensive testing phase until May 9, 2026, aims to centralize access to online public services, thereby reducing processing times and significantly improving the citizen experience.
Un projet stratégique pour l’État algéri: A strategic project for the Algerian state
Le PN2D s’inscrit dans une dynamique glo: The PN2D is part of a global drive to modernize the administration, with the objective of digitizing 100% of administrative procedures in the coming years. The ongoing tests, conducted on pilot sites across the country, make it possible to evaluate the platform's robustness, the quality of responses, and user adoption. A methodical approach that reflects the authorities' determination to guarantee a solution adapted to local realities.
Parmi les services envisagés pour une in: Among the services planned for future integration are:
Les demandes de documents administratifs: Applications for administrative documents (CIN, passports, etc.)
Les démarches liées à la santé et aux re: Procedures related to health and pensions
Un écosystème télécoms algérien en souti: An Algerian telecom ecosystem in support
L’Algérie dispose d’un secteur des téléc: Algeria has a rapidly expanding telecommunications sector, with three major operators: Mobilis (Algérie Télécom), Djezzy (Orascom Telecom Algérie), and Ooredoo Algérie. These players play a key role in the deployment of the PN2D, providing the necessary infrastructure for seamless interconnection between public services and citizens.
Avec un taux de pénétration mobile dépas: With a mobile penetration rate exceeding 120% and 4G coverage extending to over 90% of the territory, Algeria has fertile ground for a 100% digital administration. The PN2D could thus build on this solid foundation to offer an optimal user experience, while strengthening the country's technological sovereignty.
L’un des défis majeurs du projet reste l: One of the major challenges of the project remains bridging the digital divide, particularly in rural areas and remote regions. The ongoing tests incorporate accessibility evaluation mechanisms for less-connected populations, with adapted solutions (digital kiosks, human support, etc.).
Si les résultats des tests s’avèrent con: If the test results prove conclusive, the PN2D could become a regional model for digital transformation, demonstrating Algeria's potential in the field of information technology.
Bien que la date officielle de lancement: Although the official launch date has not yet been communicated, the authorities are counting on a gradual deployment starting in 2026, subject to feedback from the ongoing tests. Once operational, the PN2D could serve as a reference for other African countries, positioning Algeria as a key player in technological innovation on the continent.
